prompt: Benzylic bromination of ethylbenzene with NBS/hν. Draw the major product.

traps.note: Br goes benzylic (most stable radical), not terminal.

explanation: The benzylic C–H is weakest (~90 kcal/mol vs ~100 for other sp³ C–H) because the resulting benzyl radical is heavily resonance-stabilized by the ring. NBS/hν selectively abstracts there.
